cases.material_ambiguity: Material YES/INSUFFICIENT boundary: the contract permits unnumbered references and says unknown targets alone do not justify INSUFFICIENT. It expressly makes a bare cut-off Section insufficient when its public-legal sense cannot be established, but "the tenant’s statutory remedy is set out in Section" does establish that sense. cases.material_ambiguity: Material heading/isolated-identifier boundary: "PART IV. PROCEDURES [Sections 41–46]" visibly resembles a source heading, rather than a bare identifier with no role-establishing wording. The contract excludes headings outside focus and assigns INSUFFICIENT to isolated identifiers only when their body-versus-heading role cannot be determined. It leaves identifiable headings inside focus unspecified; NO (heading role established, no body reference), INSUFFICIENT (all heading-only inputs), and potentially YES (a legal range visibly present inside focus) follow different reasonable readings. State explicitly how identified source headings inside focus are handled, or use a genuinely role-ambiguous isolated identifier before execution.
